from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityAdmissionData(BaseModel):
    """Raw admission and enrollment counts for one university's first-year cohort."""
    university_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the university")
    applicants: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year, degree-seeking applicants")
    admitted: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year, degree-seeking students admitted")
    enrolled: int | None = Field(description="Number of first-time, first-year, degree-seeking students enrolled")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The academic year or semester for this report, in YYYY-MM format if available")
    source_section: str | None = Field(description="The CDS section this data came from, e.g., 'C1'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityAdmissionData]
